title: The Mystery House
intro: You've inherited a mysterious old house from a distant relative. Strange things have been reported here. As you step through the front door, it slams shut behind you...

entrance_hall.name: Entrance Hall
entrance_hall.description: You stand in a dusty entrance hall. A grand staircase leads upward, and doors lead east and west. Cobwebs hang from the chandelier above.

items.name: note
items.description: A yellowed note that reads: 'The secret lies where the sun never shines, but answers illuminate.'

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: An old-fashioned kitchen with a rusty stove and empty cupboards. A door leads north to the garden. Everything is covered in a thick layer of dust.

items.name: knife
items.description: A sharp kitchen knife. Handle with care.
items.use_message: You grip the knife defensively. It might be useful for protection or cutting things.

items.name: candle
items.description: A half-melted candle. It could provide light in dark places.
items.use_message: You light the candle. A warm glow illuminates your surroundings.

living_room.name: Living Room
living_room.description: A once-elegant living room now fallen into disrepair. Faded portraits hang on the walls, their eyes seeming to follow you. A bookshelf covers the north wall.

items.name: portrait
items.description: A portrait of a stern-looking man in Victorian dress. Behind it, you notice scratches on the wall.

items.name: book
items.description: An old leather-bound journal. The last entry mentions 'the basement holds the truth.'

garden.name: Garden
garden.description: A wild, overgrown garden. Vines have taken over everything. In the corner, you see what looks like a cellar door, chained shut.

items.name: shovel
items.use_message: You swing the shovel. It could be used to dig or break things.

upstairs_landing.name: Upstairs Landing
upstairs_landing.description: A dim landing with three doors: one to the east, west, and north. The floorboards creak ominously beneath your feet.

bedroom.name: Master Bedroom
bedroom.description: A large bedroom with a four-poster bed covered in dusty sheets. Moonlight filters through torn curtains.

items.name: diary
items.description: A personal diary. The last page reads: 'I've hidden the key where I keep my reflection.'

bathroom.name: Bathroom
bathroom.description: An old bathroom with a cracked mirror and a clawfoot tub. The mirror has strange symbols etched into it.

items.name: key
items.description: A brass key hidden behind the mirror. It's cold to the touch.
items.use_message: You hold the key. It must unlock something important...

study.name: Study
study.description: A cramped study filled with papers and strange diagrams. A telescope points out the window at the night sky.

items.name: map
items.description: A hand-drawn map of the house. It shows a basement that you haven't found yet!

items.name: telescope
items.description: An expensive brass telescope. Looking through it, you see mysterious lights in the forest beyond.
items.use_message: You peer through the telescope. Strange lights dance in the distant woods...
